title: DairySocialTwin: Auditing the video-to-graph evidence chain in cattle social networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.32989v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video-derived social graphs can appear precise while inheriting uncertainty from detection, tracking, classification, and aggregation. We present DairySocialTwin, a graph-centered audit framework applied to 203 videos (122 h 23 min) from 15 views at three commercial dairy farms. Curation retained 447 of 839 candidate clips; 400 entered a frozen source-clip index, including 71 legacy clips with unavailable farm and time metadata. Five models were compared on a development split, with an NRI-style model retained as an exploratory trade-off between class balance and dyadic output. In a 90-min manual audit, reconciliation improved switches, fragmentation, and continuous-track duration across three gap definitions, but constrained identity capacity and inherited detector errors limited claims of identity accuracy. translated_title: DairySocialTwin：审计牛群社交网络中从视频到图谱的证据链
translated_abstract: 基于视频生成的社交图谱可能看起来很精确，但同时也继承了来自检测、跟踪、分类和聚合等环节的不确定性。我们提出了DairySocialTwin，一个以图谱为中心的审计框架，应用于三个商业化奶牛场15个视角的203段视频（共计122小时23分钟）。经数据筛选，839个候选片段中保留了447个；其中400个片段进入了冻结的源片段索引，包括71个缺少农场和时间元数据的遗留片段。在开发集上比较了五个模型，最终保留了一个NRI风格的模型，作为类别平衡与二元组输出之间的探索性权衡。在90分钟的人工审计中，协调处理在三种间隙定义下均改善了切换次数、轨迹碎片化和连续轨迹时长，但受限制的身份容量和继承自检测器的误差限制了对身份准确性的断言。匹配的人工摘要与协调后的摘要显示出粗略的一致性以及对分配的敏感性。相机特定的语义、观测……
tldr: 提出了DairySocialTwin框架，通过审计视频到社交图谱的完整证据链，量化奶牛社交网络中检测、跟踪、分类和聚合各环节引入并传播的不确定性。
en_tdlr: DairySocialTwin is a graph-centered audit framework that traces how uncertainty from video detection, tracking, classification, and aggregation propagates into cattle social network graphs.
